# Enlazer — #1 NFC Smart Cards & Digital Profiles in Nigeria & Africa

> Enlazer is Nigeria's and Africa's #1 NFC Smart Card, Digital Profile, and Smart Connectivity platform.

## Overview
Enlazer enables professionals, founders, realtors, executives, creators, and teams to share their digital contact profiles, WhatsApp, socials, portfolios, and vCard contacts with a single NFC tap or QR code scan.

## Products & Features
- **NFC Smart Cards**: High-finish custom NFC contactless business cards delivered across FCT Abuja, Lagos, and all 36 Nigerian states.
- **NFC Wristbands**: IP68 waterproof contactless NFC wristbands for events, networking, and outdoor active professionals.
- **Instant Digital Profile Studio**: Live customizable profile builder with dynamic link management, leads capture, and analytics.
